en.commentary:
I put the Toro Power Max e26 at number one, and the reason is the steel. Toro built the housing, frame, chute and deflector out of steel, gave the machine a 26-inch clearing width and a 20-inch intake, then added a third battery port on the deck so a 70-minute runtime extends without a walk back to the garage. That combination holds its line through the packed ridge a plow leaves across the end of a driveway, which is the single hardest thing a residential machine is asked to do. Toro rates it at roughly 30 car spaces in ten inches of snow on one charge, enough for a two-car driveway and the sidewalk with margin left over.

The bigger story this season is price. Steel and aluminum have carried a 50 percent tariff since April, derivatives carry 25 percent, and steel mill products ran more than 20 percent above last year as of January. A snow blower is a steel box with a motor bolted to it, so the whole category moved. Gas machines absorbed the increase hardest because metal dominates their bill of materials, and that closed the gap that used to make gas the automatic value pick. The Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO at $1,699 and the Toro Power Max e26 at $1,899 now sit close enough that fuel, oil, carburetor cleaning and spring storage decide the purchase.

Gas still wins in one specific place, and it is a real place. If you get 18 inches at a time, if your driveway climbs a grade, or if a February storm in your town runs eight hours straight, the Honda HSS724AWD and the Ariens Platinum 24 SHO finish work that a battery machine leaves for a second charge. You refuel in ninety seconds and keep going. Buy for your worst storm rather than your average one, and buy before the first snow appears in the ten-day forecast, because inventory tightens and prices climb the week it does.

highlights.title: Steel construction is why a battery machine takes the top spot this year
highlights.body: The e26 uses steel for the housing, frame, chute and deflector, and that is the whole argument. The end-of-driveway ridge left by a municipal plow is dense, refrozen and full of road grit, and it is the load that separates a machine that finishes from a machine that rides up and over. Toro paired that structure with a 20-inch intake and a 26-inch cut, which matches what its own 252cc gas machines clear. Battery two-stage design reached parity on width and intake first, and this is the model where it reached parity on structure too.

highlights.title: The tariff wave has ended the gas value argument
highlights.body: Steel and aluminum have carried a 50 percent tariff since April with derivatives at 25 percent, and steel mill products were running over 20 percent year over year in January. Gas two-stage machines are the most metal-intensive product in this category, so they took the largest increase. A Toro Power Max 826 OHAE now lists at $1,599 and the battery Power Max e26 at $1,899. That $300 gap covers roughly three winters of fuel, oil changes and a carburetor service, which means the total cost of ownership now favors the battery machine for anyone clearing a normal residential driveway.

highlights.title: Buy for your worst storm, and buy in September
highlights.body: Sizing on an average snowfall is the most expensive mistake in this category, because the machine you actually remember is the one that stalled during the storm that mattered. If your area sees single events over 12 inches, start at a 24-inch two-stage with a 20-inch intake. Timing matters just as much. Dealer and big-box inventory prices firm up the week snow enters the ten-day forecast, and the deepest discounts on last season's carryover stock sit in late August and September, before anyone is thinking about it.

highlights.title: Honda's premium is earned on a grade
highlights.body: The HSS724AWD costs roughly double a comparable 24-inch machine, and I still recommend it for sloped driveways. Hydrostatic drive gives you continuously variable speed under load rather than fixed gears you shift between, and true all-wheel drive keeps both wheels pulling when one loses grip on ice. On a flat suburban driveway that capability sits unused, so the value case depends entirely on your terrain. Walk your driveway before you decide, and if there is a grade you have ever slipped on, the Honda pays for itself the first winter.

highlights.title: A single-stage machine is a nine-inch tool, and that is a legitimate choice
highlights.body: The Toro Power Clear e21 handles 2 to 9 inches on a paved surface, weighs 55 pounds and clears about a 12-car driveway on one charge. For a townhouse apron, a city sidewalk or a second machine kept by the back door, that is exactly the right amount of tool. It stores upright in a closet, needs no fuel stabilizer and starts on a trigger pull. Anyone whose region tops out around 8 inches per storm should look at this before spending three times as much on capacity they will use twice.

zh-tw.commentary:
我把 Toro Power Max e26 放第一，理由很簡單，它整台是鋼的。外殼、車架、拋雪管、導流罩全部鋼製，清雪寬度 66 公分，進雪口 50 公分高，機身上還多留一個電池插槽，70 分鐘的續航可以直接往上疊，不用走回車庫換電池。這個配置最關鍵的地方是掃雪車推過去之後留在車道口那道壓實的雪堤，那是家用機器一整個冬天最難處理的一段，鋼製結構過得去。原廠標的是十英吋積雪下單次充電清完約三十個車位，一般兩車位車道加人行道還有餘裕。

老實說，今年這個榜真正的變數是價格。四月起美國對鋼鋁課 50% 關稅，衍生品 25%，一月鋼材價格年增超過兩成。掃雪機說穿了就是一個鐵箱子裝一顆馬達，整個品類直接往上跳，汽油機因為金屬佔料最重，漲得最兇。以前「汽油機比較划算」這個結論，今年已經站不住了。Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO 標 1,699 美元，換算五萬出頭，Toro e26 標 1,899 美元，接近六萬，差距縮到這種程度，決定勝負的就變成汽油、機油、化油器保養跟春天入庫這些雜事。

不過汽油機還是有它非贏不可的場合。一場雪下 45 公分、車道有坡、或是二月一場暴風雪連下八小時，Honda HSS724AWD 跟 Ariens Platinum 24 SHO 這種等級才做得完，加油九十秒繼續開。買機器要看你家最糟的那場雪，不要看平均值，而且要在氣象預報出現雪之前買，第一波預報一出來庫存就緊、價格就往上跑。

highlights.title: 今年榜首讓給電池機，關鍵在鋼
highlights.body: e26 的外殼、車架、拋雪管、導流罩全部用鋼，這就是它排第一的全部理由。市府掃雪車推過去之後在車道口留下的那道雪堤，密度高、二次結凍、裡面還混著路面砂石，能不能吃掉這一段，就是「清完」跟「爬上去空轉」的分界。Toro 在這個結構上配了 50 公分進雪口跟 66 公分清雪寬度，跟它自家 252cc 汽油機同級。電池雙段機在寬度跟進雪口上早就追上汽油機了，這台是連結構強度也追上的那一代。

highlights.title: 關稅這一波，直接終結了「汽油機比較划算」
highlights.body: 四月起鋼鋁 50% 關稅、衍生品 25%，一月鋼材價格年增超過兩成。汽油雙段機是這個品類裡金屬佔比最高的產品，漲最多的就是它。現在 Toro Power Max 826 OHAE 標 1,599 美元，電池版 Power Max e26 標 1,899 美元，中間差 300 美元，換算不到一萬台幣。這一萬塊大概等於三個冬天的汽油、換機油加一次化油器保養。也就是說，一般住宅車道的使用者，總持有成本這一局已經倒向電池機了。

highlights.title: 買機器看你家最糟的那場雪，而且九月就要買
highlights.body: 這個品類最貴的錯誤就是照「平均降雪量」挑機器，因為你真正會記住的，永遠是那場關鍵暴風雪裡卡住的那一台。如果你所在地區單場降雪會超過 30 公分，起跳就要 24 吋雙段、進雪口 50 公分。時間點一樣重要。經銷商跟大賣場的庫存價格會在雪進入十日預報的那一週開始變硬，上一季的庫存出清最深的折扣在八月底到九月，剛好是所有人都還沒在想這件事的時候。

highlights.title: Honda 貴一倍，貴在坡道上
highlights.body: HSS724AWD 大概是同級 24 吋機的兩倍價，我還是會推薦給車道有坡的人。液壓無段變速讓你在重載下速度連續可調，真正的四輪驅動則是在其中一輪踩到冰打滑時，另一輪還在出力。平坦的郊區車道上這些能力用不到，所以它的划算與否完全取決於你家的地形。決定之前先自己走一次車道，只要有那種你曾經滑過一次的坡，這台第一個冬天就回本。

highlights.title: 單段機就是一台九英吋的工具，這也是合理選擇
highlights.body: Toro Power Clear e21 處理鋪面上 5 到 23 公分的積雪，整機 25 公斤，一顆電池清完約十二個車位。連棟住宅前庭、市區人行道，或是放在後門當第二台備用機，這個量的工具剛剛好。它可以直立收在儲藏室，不用加油精，扣板機就啟動。單場降雪最多八英吋的地區，先看這台，不用多花三倍的錢去買一輩子用兩次的清雪量。

en.commentary:
Pre-season is the only sensible time to buy a snow blower and we are in it right now. Manufacturers release next-season inventory in late August and September, dealers run pre-season programmes with free assembly and delivery, and none of that exists in December when a storm is forecast and every unit within fifty miles is gone. Buying in August is worth 10 to 20 percent plus the assembly service.

The Toro Power Max e26 holds first place and my reasoning centres on one design decision. Toro's anti-clogging chute system handles the wet heavy snow that jams almost everything else, and wet snow is the condition where a snow blower either earns its keep or sits in the garage while you shovel. The 60V battery platform delivers enough runtime for a two-car driveway with the storm still coming down.

The EGO SNT2405 at second is the strongest argument for going battery if you are already in the EGO ecosystem. Steel-and-aluminium tariffs have pushed prices up across this whole category, and battery platform sharing is one of the few ways left to reduce the real cost of ownership.

Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO at third stays my pick for anyone clearing more than a hundred feet of driveway or dealing with end-of-driveway plow piles. That is where a gas machine with a heavy auger and real weight over the wheels still wins outright.

One pre-season job. If you own a gas machine, drain last season's fuel before you store or start it. Ethanol-blended fuel left sitting since March is the single most common reason a snow blower will not start in December.

highlights.title: Buy now, pre-season pricing is worth 10 to 20 percent plus free assembly
highlights.body: Manufacturers push next-season stock out in late August and September, and dealers pair it with pre-season assembly and delivery programmes. None of that exists once a storm is in the forecast, when availability collapses and you take whatever is left on the floor. This is the cheapest and widest-selection week of the entire snow blower year.

highlights.title: Toro Power Max e26 leads on wet snow, which is the real test
highlights.body: Wet heavy snow is what jams chutes and it is the condition that decides whether the machine gets used or you end up shovelling anyway. Toro's anti-clogging chute system handles it, and the 60V platform holds enough runtime to clear a two-car driveway mid-storm. That combination is why it stays at 9.3.

highlights.title: Tariffs on steel and aluminium make battery platform sharing worth more
highlights.body: Prices across this category have moved up on materials costs, so reducing what you pay for the parts you already own matters. The EGO SNT2405 runs on packs you may already have from mowers and blowers, and that shared platform is one of the few remaining ways to bring real ownership cost down in a category that is getting more expensive.

highlights.title: Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO still wins on long driveways and plow piles
highlights.body: For more than a hundred feet of driveway, or for the compacted ridge a municipal plow leaves at the end of it, weight over the wheels and a heavy steel auger are what get through. The Ariens is the machine I recommend without hesitation for that job, and its 9.0 reflects a specific strength rather than an all-round compromise.

zh-tw.commentary:
季前是唯一合理的掃雪機採購時機，而我們現在就在這個窗口裡。

原廠在八月底到九月釋出下一季的庫存，經銷商配合季前方案提供免費組裝與運送，這些在十二月暴風雪預報一出來的時候通通不存在，那時候方圓五十英里內能買的都被掃光了。八月買下去，價差加上組裝服務，大概值一到兩成。

Toro Power Max e26 守第一，我的理由集中在一個設計決定上。Toro 的防堵拋雪口系統處理得了濕重雪，而濕重雪幾乎會卡死其他所有機器。濕雪就是那個「機器有沒有價值」的分水嶺，卡住的話你還是得拿鏟子出去。60V 電池平台的續航足以在雪還在下的時候清完一個雙車位車道。

第二名 EGO SNT2405，如果你本來就有 EGO 的電池，這是換電動最強的理由。鋼鋁關稅把整個品類的價格往上推，共用電池平台是現在少數還能壓低實際持有成本的方法。

第三名 Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO，車道超過三十公尺、或是要處理市政鏟雪車堆在車道口那道硬雪牆的人，我還是推它。那種場合就是重量壓在輪上加上厚實鋼製絞龍才吃得下來。

季前該做的一件事，燃油機請把上一季的舊油放掉再收或再發動。三月放到現在的酒精汽油，是十二月發不動的第一名原因。

highlights.title: 現在買，季前價差加組裝服務值一到兩成
highlights.body: 原廠八月底到九月出下一季的貨，經銷商搭配季前組裝與運送方案。等到暴風雪進了預報，這些全部消失，供貨崩掉，你只能買架上剩下的。這是掃雪機一整年當中最便宜、選擇最多的一週。

highlights.title: Toro Power Max e26 贏在濕雪，那才是真正的考題
highlights.body: 濕重雪是卡住拋雪口的元兇，也是決定你會用機器還是回去拿鏟子的關鍵。Toro 的防堵設計吃得下來，60V 平台的續航也足以在暴風雪中途清完雙車位車道。這個組合讓它守在 9.3。

highlights.title: 鋼鋁關稅之下，共用電池平台的價值變高了
highlights.body: 材料成本推高整個品類的價格，所以「你已經擁有的零件不用再付一次錢」變得更重要。EGO SNT2405 用的是你可能已經有的割草機、吹葉機電池，這種平台共用是這個越來越貴的品類裡，少數還能壓低實際成本的方法。

highlights.title: 長車道與硬雪牆，Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO 還是贏
highlights.body: 三十公尺以上的車道，或是鏟雪車在車道口留下的那道壓實雪牆，靠的是輪上的重量與厚實鋼製絞龍。這個任務我會毫不猶豫推 Ariens，它的 9.0 分反映的是一項明確的專長。

en.commentary: The Toro Power Max e26 holds first because it delivers two-stage clearing performance on a battery platform, and that combination removes the fuel storage, winter starting problems, and maintenance that make gas machines tiresome. A machine that starts every time in cold weather is worth a great deal when the snow is already on the ground. EGO SNT2405 at 9.1 offers a broader battery ecosystem shared with other outdoor tools, which is worth counting if you already own EGO equipment. Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO at 9.0 remains the gas standard and its clearing width covers a wide driveway in fewer passes. Honda HSS724AWD at 8.9 has the best build quality here and the hydrostatic drive handles slopes properly. Ariens Platinum 24 SHO at 8.7 balances width and manoeuvrability. My practical guidance: match clearing width to your driveway rather than buying the largest available, since a machine too wide for the space becomes awkward to manoeuvre and one too narrow doubles your passes. Battery models need spare packs in genuinely cold conditions, because low temperatures reduce capacity significantly.

highlights.title: Battery two-stage removes the fuel problem

en.commentary:
Snow blowers are the clearest buying timing case on this site. Pricing bottoms out in late summer and early autumn, and rises sharply the week of the first forecast snowfall. If you need one this winter, buying in September costs meaningfully less than buying in December, and December is when the model you want is out of stock.

That argument is stronger this year because of tariffs. Power equipment under HTS 8467.11 carries a US rate around 34 percent, up from zero before 2025, and Section 232 duties on steel apply to the augers, housings and chutes that make up most of a snow blower's mass. Prices reflect that and there is no indication of relief.

On the products, the specification that determines whether the machine handles your driveway is stage count. Single stage machines use an auger that contacts the ground and works well on paved surfaces with up to about eight inches of snow. Two stage machines add an impeller that throws snow further and handle deeper snow and gravel driveways. Three stage adds an accelerator for very heavy wet snow.

Match the stage count to your typical snowfall and surface, because a single stage machine on a gravel driveway throws stones.

The Toro Power Max e26 holds first at 9.3 as a two stage battery machine with throughput that matches gas equivalents. The EGO SNT2405 at 9.1 is the other strong battery option.

One note. Buy now and store it. This is the cheapest month of the year for this category.
